385:   line-height: 1.3;
386: }
387: 
388: .stat span {
389:   display: block;
390:   margin-top: 3px;
391:   font-size: 12px;
392:   letter-spacing: 0.07em;
393:   text-transform: uppercase;
394:   color: var(--muted);
395: }
396: 
397: .db-value {
398:   font-size: 17px !important;
399:   text-transform: lowercase;
400: }
401: 
402: .db-dot {
403:   width: 9px;
404:   height: 9px;
405:   border-radius: 50%;
406:   background: var(--muted);
407: }
408: 
409: .is-up .db-dot {
410:   background: var(--accent);
411:   box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(61, 252, 147, 0.85);
412: }
413: 
414: .is-down .db-dot {
415:   background: var(--amber);
416:   box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.7);
417: }
418: 
419: /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
420: 
421: .section {
422:   max-width: var(--max);
423:   margin: 0 auto;
424:   padding: 88px 24px;
425: }
426: 
427: .section-alt {
428:   max-width: none;
429:   border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
430:   border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
431:   background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.014), transparent 40%),
432:     var(--bg-2);
433: }
434: 
435: .section-alt .section-head,
436: .section-alt .steps {
437:   max-width: calc(var(--max) - 48px);
438:   margin-left: auto;
439:   margin-right: auto;
440: }
441: 
442: .section-head {
443:   max-width: 660px;
444:   margin-bottom: 46px;
445: }
446: 
447: .kicker {
448:   display: block;
449:   font-family: var(--mono);
450:   font-size: 12px;
451:   letter-spacing: 0.14em;
452:   text-transform: uppercase;
453:   color: var(--accent);
454: }
455: 
456: .section h2,
457: .waitlist-card h2 {
458:   margin: 14px 0 14px;
459:   font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
460:   line-height: 1.18;
461:   letter-spacing: -0.02em;
462: }
463: 
464: .section-head p {
465:   margin: 0;
466:   color: var(--text-dim);
467:   font-size: 16.5px;
468:   line-height: 1.68;
469: }
470: 
471: /* ---------- Feature cards ---------- */
472: 
473: .cards {
474:   display: grid;
475:   grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(292px, 1fr));
476:   gap: 18px;
477: }
478: 
479: .card {
480:   padding: 25px 24px 26px;
481:   border: 1px solid var(--line);
482:   border-radius: var(--radius);
483:   background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), transparent 55%),
484:     var(--panel);
485:   transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
486: }
487: 
488: .card:hover {
489:   border-color: rgba(61, 252, 147, 0.35);
490:   transform: translateY(-3px);
491:   box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -26px rgba(61, 252, 147, 0.35);
492: }
493: 
494: .card-ico {
495:   width: 40px;
496:   height: 40px;
497:   display: grid;
498:   place-items: center;
499:   margin-bottom: 17px;
500:   border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
501:   border-radius: 9px;
502:   background: var(--accent-soft);
503:   color: var(--accent);
504: }
505: 
506: .card h3 {
507:   margin: 0 0 9px;
508:   font-size: 16.5px;
509:   letter-spacing: -0.01em;
510: }
511: 
512: .card p {
513:   margin: 0;
514:   font-size: 14.5px;
515:   line-height: 1.65;
516:   color: var(--text-dim);
517: }
518: 
519: /* ---------- How it works ---------- */
520: 
521: .steps {
522:   display: grid;
523:   grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
524:   gap: 18px;
525: }
526: 
527: .step {
528:   position: relative;
529:   padding: 27px 25px;
530:   border: 1px solid var(--line);
531:   border-radius: var(--radius);
532:   background: var(--panel);
533: }
534: 
535: .step-num {
536:   font-family: var(--mono);
537:   font-size: 13px;
538:   letter-spacing: 0.16em;
539:   color: var(--accent);
540: }
541: 
542: .step h3 {
543:   margin: 15px 0 9px;
544:   font-size: 17.5px;
545:   letter-spacing: -0.01em;
546: }
547: 
548: .step p {
549:   margin: 0;
550:   font-size: 14.5px;
551:   line-height: 1.65;
552:   color: var(--text-dim);
553: }
554: 
555: /* ---------- Waitlist ---------- */
556: 
557: .waitlist {
558:   padding: 92px 24px;
559: }
560: 
561: .waitlist-card {
562:   max-width: 740px;
563:   margin: 0 auto;
564:   padding: 48px 46px;
565:   text-align: center;
566:   border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
567:   border-radius: 16px;
568:   background: radial-gradient(
569:       900px 260px at 50% -60%,
570:       rgba(61, 252, 147, 0.1),
571:       transparent 65%
572:     ),
573:     var(--panel);
574:   box-shadow: 0 40px 90px -50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
575:   scroll-margin-top: 90px;
576: }
577: 
578: .waitlist-lede {
579:   max-width: 56ch;
580:   margin: 0 auto;
581:   color: var(--text-dim);
582:   font-size: 15.5px;
583:   line-height: 1.65;
584: }
585: 
586: .form {
587:   display: flex;
588:   gap: 12px;
589:   margin-top: 30px;
590: }
591: 
592: .input {
593:   flex: 1 1 auto;
594:   min-width: 0;
595:   padding: 12px 15px;
596:   border: 1px solid var(--line-2);
597:   border-radius: 8px;
598:   background: #070a0e;
599:   color: var(--text);
600:   font-family: var(--sans);
601:   font-size: 15px;
602:   outline: none;
603:   transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
604: }
605: 
606: .input::placeholder {
607:   color: var(--muted);
608: }
609: 
610: .input:focus {
611:   border-color: var(--accent);
612:   box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61, 252, 147, 0.16);
613: }
614: 
615: .input-handle {
616:   flex: 0 1 170px;
617:   font-family: var(--mono);
618:   font-size: 14px;
619: }
620: 
621: .form-btn {
622:   flex: 0 0 auto;
623:   padding: 12px 22px;
624: }
625: 
626: .msg {
627:   margin: 18px 0 0;
628:   font-family: var(--mono);
629:   font-size: 13.5px;
630: }
631: 
632: .msg-err {
633:   color: var(--red);
634: }
635: 
636: .form-note {
637:   margin: 20px 0 0;
638:   font-family: var(--mono);
639:   font-size: 12px;
640:   color: var(--muted);
641: }
642: 
643: .done-title {
644:   color: var(--accent);
645: }
646: 
647: .done-note {
648:   max-width: 54ch;
649:   margin: 10px auto 0;
650:   color: var(--text-dim);
651:   font-size: 15.5px;
652:   line-height: 1.65;
653: }
654: 
655: /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
656: 
657: .footer {
658:   border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
659:   background: var(--bg-2);
660: }
661: 
662: .footer-inner {
663:   max-width: var(--max);
664:   margin: 0 auto;
665:   padding: 56px 24px 38px;
666:   display: grid;
667:   grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
668:   gap: 34px;
669: }
670: 
671: .footer-brand p {
672:   max-width: 34ch;
673:   margin: 15px 0 0;
674:   font-size: 14px;
675:   line-height: 1.6;
676:   color: var(--text-dim);
677: }
678: 
679: .footer-brand .fingerprint {
680:   font-family: var(--mono);
681:   font-size: 12.5px;
682:   line-height: 1.7;
683:   color: var(--muted);

685: 
686: .footer-col h4 {
687:   margin: 0 0 13px;
688:   font-family: var(--mono);

690:   font-weight: 600;
691:   letter-spacing: 0.12em;
692:   text-transform: uppercase;
693:   color: var(--muted);
694:   text-shadow: 0 0 7px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), 0 0 14px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
695: }
696: 
697: .footer-col a {
698:   display: block;
699:   padding: 5px 0;
700:   font-size: 14px;
701:   color: var(--text-dim);
702:   text-decoration: none;
703:   transition: color 0.15s ease;
704: }
705: 
706: .footer-col a:hover {
707:   color: var(--accent);
708: }
709: 
710: .footer-bottom {
711:   max-width: var(--max);
712:   margin: 0 auto;
713:   padding: 19px 24px;
714:   border-top: 1px solid var(--line);

716:   flex-wrap: wrap;
717:   justify-content: space-between;
718:   gap: 12px;
719:   font-family: var(--mono);
720:   font-size: 12px;
721:   color: var(--muted);
722: }

724: /* ---------- Utilities ---------- */
725: 
726: .sr-only {
727:   position: absolute;
728:   width: 1px;
729:   height: 1px;
730:   padding: 0;
731:   margin: -1px;

733:   clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
734:   white-space: nowrap;
735:   border: 0;

776: .form-col {

790: 
791: .field-label {

812: .auth-note strong {

822: 
823: .auth-note a:hover {

826: }
827: 
828: .mono {
829:   font-family: var(--mono);
830: }
831: 
832: .accent {
833:   color: var(--accent);
834: }

836: /* Account page */

1032: .admin-count {

1040: .admin-list {

1109: /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */

1111: @media (max-width: 980px) {

1113:     grid-template-columns: 1fr;

1129: }

1133:     display: none;

1145:     padding: 34px 24px;
1146:   }

1148:   .stats-inner {

1150:     gap: 20px 16px;
1151:   }
1152: 
1153:   .form {
1154:     flex-direction: column;
1155:   }
1156: 
1157:   .input-handle {
1158:     flex: 1 1 auto;
1159:   }
1160: 
1161:   .waitlist-card {
1162:     padding: 36px 24px;
1163:   }
1164: 
1165:   .section,
1166:   .waitlist {
1167:     padding: 66px 20px;
1168:   }
1169: 
1170:   .admin-page {
1171:     padding: 52px 18px 74px;
1172:   }
1173: 
1174:   .admin-card {
1175:     padding: 26px 20px;
1176:   }
1177: 
1178:   .admin-row {
1179:     flex-direction: column;

1181:   }
1182: }
1183: 
1184: @media (max-width: 480px) {

## Track D — UX & Polish ✅ Complete

### 1. TryIt component replaces Terminal demo
- **New**: `src/components/TryIt.jsx` — replaces the animated Terminal demo in the Hero section
- Shows two cards: "Read your sealed posts" (→ `/feed`) and "Write a sealed post" (→ `/compose`)
- If not logged in, clicking routes to `/login`; shows a logged-out note with links to login or request beta access
- **Updated**: `src/components/Hero.jsx` imports and renders `TryIt` instead of `Terminal`

### 2. Feed refinements (`src/pages/Feed.jsx`)
- **Unread indicators**: Tracks seen post IDs in `localStorage` (`hd:seenPosts`). Posts addressed to the user that haven't been seen yet get a pulsing amber dot and a left border accent. Clicking a row (or Enter/Space) marks it read by triggering decryption.
- **Loading skeletons**: Shows 3 skeleton post rows during initial load instead of a blank page.
- **Keyboard navigation**: Feed rows are `tabIndex={0}` with Enter/Space to trigger decryption.
- **Mobile**: Stacked feed row header on narrow screens, full-width page padding.

### 3. Compose refinements (`src/pages/Compose.jsx`)
- **Loading skeleton**: Shown while auth state loads instead of a blank page.
- **Mobile**: Stacked action buttons on narrow screens.

### 4. Styles (`src/styles.css`)
- TryIt card grid, hover states, focus-visible outlines
- Skeleton pulse animation
- Unread dot animation + left-border accent

If you still get an error, check Botkeep's **Console/logs** in their panel and share the error message — I can help troubleshoot further.
